title: Brockton B69 Generator Remote Annunciator
agency: VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF.VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF.241-NETWORK CONTRACT OFFICE 01 (36C241)
description_text: The VA Boston Healthcare System - Brockton Campus is seeking a Contractor to provide all materials, labor, equipment, programming and supervision to install a remote annunciator panel for the Building 69 generators in the Building 7, Second Floor, C-Wing Nurse Station.
